ov: أعظم رجل استعراض (الإنجليزية: The Greatest Showman) هو فيلم سيرة موسيقي درامي أمريكي من إخراج مايكل غراسي ‏، وسيناريو جيني بيكس ‏ وبيل كوندون. الفيلم من بطولة هيو جاكمان وزاك إيفرون وميشيل ويليامز وريبيكا فيرغسون وزيندايا. وهو يحكي قصة بي تي بارنوم وكيف بدأ السيرك الخاصة به الذي أصبح لاحقاً أشهر سيرك. الفيلم عرض من قبل تونتيث سينتشوري فوكس بتاريخ 25 ديسمبر 2017 في الولايات المتحدة.
plotEn:
In the 19th century, young P. T. Barnum and his tailor father, Philo, work for the wealthy Hallett family. Barnum falls in love with their daughter, Charity, and the two remain in contact while she attends finishing school. They reunite as adults ("A Million Dreams"), marry, and raise two daughters, Caroline and Helen, in New York City. Although Charity is content with their modest life, Barnum longs for success.
Barnum loses his job when the shipping company he works for goes bankrupt. He obtains a bank loan by deceptively using his former employer's lost ships as collateral and opens Barnum's American Museum in downtown Manhattan. When ticket sales remain slow, Caroline and Helen suggest that he exhibit something "alive". Barnum recruits performers with unusual physical characteristics and abilities, including bearded lady Lettie Lutz and Charles Stratton, a man with dwarfism ("Come Alive"). The show draws large audiences as well as protests and hostile reviews from critic James Gordon Bennett Sr. Barnum renames the venture "Barnum's Circus" and recruits playwright Phillip Carlyle to generate publicity ("The Other Side"). Phillip and African American trapeze artist Anne Wheeler become attracted to each other but hesitate to pursue a relationship because of racial prejudice. Phillip later arranges for Barnum and the troupe to meet Queen Victoria.
